Parry
Tap when the moving circle overlaps the fixed circle. A small timing error still gives a good result; too early or too late is a miss. The circle keeps shrinking past the target.

Timed strike

Perfect: maximum damage in the range. Good: the middle of the range. Critical hits are rolled separately.
On a control spell: good = the enemy [[resist|resists]] %1$d%% less; perfect = it rolls twice and keeps the worse.
